description: Decode N-numbers to aircraft, engine, status, and owner, and search the US civil aircraft registry (FAA Releasable Aircraft Database) by owner, type, or state — offline and keyless over an embedded SQLite + FTS5 mirror, with fail-safe owner-PII redaction.
